semiconductor_relevance: High — ASM Japan is a leading supplier of advanced wafer processing equipment, particularly in Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) and epitaxy, crucial for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: ASM Japan specializes in advanced wafer processing equipment, focusing on Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) and silicon epitaxy. With a strong market presence and expertise in thin-film deposition, ASM empowers semiconductor manufacturers to enhance device performance and reliability.
capabilities: Epitaxy equipment for silicon and silicon-compound films

regional_presence.Japan: ASM has operated in Japan since 1982, with seven offices and over 380 employees, including R&D centers in Tama and Kawasaki.
